text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] <= df['IN_PKTS']) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] <= df['OUT_PKTS'])"],"features":["RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS","IN_PKTS","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS","OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"Retransmitted packets in each direction are subsets of the packets observed in that direction."},{"id":"R2","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["(df['NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES']) <= (df['IN_PKTS'] + df['OUT_PKTS'])"],"features":["NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES","IN_PKTS","OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"The size buckets count mutually exclusive packets from the flow, so their total cannot exceed all packets in both directions; packets larger than the largest bucket may be unclassified."}]}
